title: GTA6 Cover Painting: Colossal Media Rumored to Return
description: Recent community reports suggest that Colossal Media, Rockstar's 22-year partner for cover paintings, is returning for the GTA6 promotional campaign.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Cover Art Tradition: A Longtime Partnership Rumored to Continue

As the gaming community eagerly awaits more official updates regarding Grand Theft Auto VI, new discussions are constantly emerging across online platforms. Recently, a post on the r/GTA6 Reddit community brought attention to the marketing and artistic side of the franchise, suggesting a familiar name is returning for the upcoming game's promotional campaign.

## A 22-Year Collaborative Legacy

According to information shared by Reddit user /u/RealGiancarlosR, Colossal Media is reportedly returning to paint the GTA 6 cover. This marks a continuation of a massive creative relationship, as this is the exact same company Rockstar Games has utilized over the last 22 years for their iconic cover paintings and hand-painted street murals.

Furthermore, historical trivia highlighted in the community points out that Rockstar Games was actually Colossal Media's very first client. This remarkable piece of trivia underscores a deeply rooted business relationship that has spanned over two decades, making the potential continuation of this partnership a significant point of interest for long-time fans of the franchise.

## Evaluating the Community Report (Unconfirmed Rumor)

As this information originates from a community forum post, it is important to treat it as an unconfirmed rumor until an official statement or visual evidence is provided by Rockstar Games. Nonetheless, the historical precedent makes the collaboration entirely plausible, keeping the community's anticipation high for future promotional reveals.

## Editor's Take

While this report remains unconfirmed, the 22-year history between Rockstar Games and Colossal Media highlights a commitment to traditional, high-impact marketing. If true, seeing their hand-painted artistry return for GTA 6 would be a fantastic nod to the franchise's legendary rollout history.
